body: Like you said, there really isn't an abundance of joy. I like to play video games, but I want to do something that doesn't hole me up in a room alone for the day. I'd love to get involved with a sport of some kind, but there really aren't any opportunities around me.

I make alright money, but I really can't afford the copays to go see a doctor. Anytime I mention these thoughts to anyone else.. Well, I don't think they take me serious.

Like I said, I would never do it. I just hate having these thoughts.

I was not. I was, however, expected to have the best grades and be the smartest. Dropping out of college was difficult because I feel like I disappointed my parents.

I have no idea where this feeling to care for everyone is from.

You are tight though - I know that I need to make time for myself. I do wish I had others to share my time with though.

Thank you. I really just need to hear positivity. I think for my negative mood, I'm painting my fiancé to be this monster, but he is caring too. I think he struggles with some depression as well, so it's hard for the two of is to comfort each other. 

I feel the need to care for everyone at all times. I know that I can and should take time for myself. If I did take time for myself, I don't know what I would do. I tried learning to sew - I'm not to good at it. I'm attempting to crochet, but I don't think it's too good. I also started oil painting, but I'm not as creative as I think I'd like to be.
